decisions.reason: A schlager compilation fits the label's core catalog. Back-catalog CDs cost little to keep in a warehouse-backed shop, and with industry turnover growing there is no shortfall to prompt problemistic search.
The illustrated release series builds on the firm's curation strength and was featured on its own page for two years. That suggests satisfactory results and gives no reason to drop it.
Jazz vinyl reissues match the firm's stated push to broaden genres and formats and its strong vinyl collector demand, so the product likely meets aspirations.
Multi-disc box sets are a signature format for the firm. Limited pressings may sell out, but stock can be held at low cost, so the firm will likely keep it on offer.
The compilation CD was only mentioned, not featured, so it is less prominent. Still, carrying it within a 60,000-item catalog costs little, and the firm has enough slack to keep it.
